allot.subject: Conversion
allot.text: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has informed the Stock Exchange for the partial conversion of Compulsorily Convertible Debentures and thereupon allotment of Equity shares.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Allotment of shares by Onega Solar Pvt Ltd., a step down subsidiary of the Company. Onega Solar is a SPV for development of Group Captive Solar Project.

allot.subject: Options to purchase securities
allot.text: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has submitted with the Stock Exchange regarding approval by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee of the Board of Directors of the Company, to grant Employee Stock Options to the eligible employees under Samvardhana Motherson International Limited   Employee Stock Option Scheme 2025.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has submitted to Stock Exchange the Trust Deed , namely, "Motherson ESOP Trust".

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has informed the exchange regarding allotment of 351,81,47,534 no. of Bonus shares.

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 2,02,500 Rated, Listed, Unsecured, Redeemable, Non Convertible Debenture having face value of INR 1,00,000/- each for cash aggregating to INR 2025,00,00,000/- on private placement basis on June 27, 2025.

allot.subject: Options to purchase securities
allot.text: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has submitted with exchange regarding approval of Employee Stock Option Scheme in the Board Meeting held on June 19, 2025 and recommended for shareholder approval.
